desc:
In this 2014 GDC Next session, MMO designer Raph Koster explains what science tells us about creativity, and offers practical straightforward steps that any game designer or developer can make use of in order to get more creative. 

GDC talks cover a range of developmental topics including game design, programming, audio, visual arts, business management, production, online games, and much more. W

recs.stt: Ultima Online spent years developing a system that was destroyed by players
recs.x:
Ultima Online in its early iterations was truly a magical game and helped to define a lot of the core design patterns of MMORPGs. The lead designer of UO, Raph Koster, has a lot of great insight when it comes to game design. I recommend his 2014 GDC talk, "Practical Creativity" [1], even to developers who are not interested in game development.
